interpretation.preliminary: Gate reliably skips previous wasteful large-case probes and selects some finite unit-producing cases.
interpretation.critical: Adaptive gate is still 1.19-1.20 times slower on CaDiCaL and around 1.30 times slower on Glucose4 for frozen public small cases (full wall median ratios).
interpretation.mechanistic: 22/60 admissions, of which 13 yield entailed units, 9 yield none; 2 missed opportunities to yield units. These counts are not speed-saving true positives.
interpretation.large: All five n18/n220/n240 old large cases are skipped by adaptive filter; the prior unconditional ~7001 probe visits are avoided but input scan itself costs time.
interpretation.next: No production promotion. Require external blinded difficult cases, per-variant isolated RSS, independent newly produced UNSAT proofs, more stable paired runs, comparison with built-in CDCL simplifications.

limitations: Both hosts are GitHub-hosted, not separate independently owned verifiers.
Original public 60-case corpus is known from TIME-SAT-001; no external hidden benchmark.
2,000 bootstrap resamples of 60 existing instances do not create 2,000 independent hidden examples.
No per-variant peak RSS (only whole-process ru_maxrss in raw artifact).
No independently replayable new UNSAT proof; solver agreement alone insufficient.
Branch-level HEAD and pull-request GITHUB_SHA reflect distinct GitHub ref semantics; actual run head fixed to 349508.
Initial false fixture corrected and failing first CI retained in history.
Performance FAIL against raw strong CDCL; keep C023/main untouched.
